Remuneration is in the form of an annual honorarium and sitting allowances for Board and Board Committee meetings.
The level and structure of the Chairman’s remuneration will primarily be compared against Kenyan best practice.

The quantum and structure of the Chairman’s remuneration is reviewed annually by the BNRC, which makes a
recommendation to the Board.
The Chairman is provided with support and reasonable travelling expenses.

All reasonable travelling, accommodation and other expenses (including any relevant tax) incurred in carrying out
duties as Chairman are reimbursed.
The rates applicable for reimbursements are in line with internally approved scales applicable to the Executive
Director(s).
